description: Search the General Osteopathic Council's public register (osteopathy.org.uk) by postcode/town, surname or practice features, or look up exact GOsC registration numbers.

disabilityAccess.description: Only return osteopaths practising at a location that reports disabled access.
disabilityAccess.title: Has disabled access (mode=search)

homeVisit.description: Only return osteopaths practising at a location that offers home visits.
homeVisit.title: Does home visits (mode=search)

location.description: UK postcode or town/city name to search near, e.g. "London" or "SW1A 1AA". Leave blank to browse the whole register.
location.title: Postcode or town (mode=search)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of osteopath records to return in this run.
maxItems.title: Max osteopaths to return

enumTitles: Search the register (postcode / town / surname / practice features)
Lookup by exact GOsC registration number(s)
mode.title: Mode

radius.description: Distance from the postcode entered in `location`. Only applies when `location` is a postcode — ignored for town/city names.
radius.title: Search radius (mode=search, postcode only)

registrationNumbers.description: Exact GOsC registration numbers to look up, e.g. "1766".
registrationNumbers.title: Registration numbers (mode=byRegistrationNumbers)

surname.description: Filter to osteopaths whose surname contains this text. Can be combined with `location`.
surname.title: Osteopath surname (mode=search)

welshSpoken.description: Only return osteopaths practising at a location where Welsh is spoken.
welshSpoken.title: Welsh spoken (mode=search)

title: UK Osteopath Register Scraper Input
